text:
Sasha: Quick pulse — I started a micro-cascade bring-up for llama3-13b q4 on the onboard-qc-v2 set. posting quick numbers + asks.
Maria: micro-cascade = ? high-level please
Sasha: Two-stage speculative: cheap q4 fast-pass for most tokens, fall back to q8 hotpath when confidence low. lightweight coordinator decides per-token. aim: lower tail latency without big cost hit.
Jonah: Nice. initial perf?
Sasha: Local bench on p4d-like nodes, 4096 ctx, batch=8: throughput ~1.6x vs baseline q8-only. median token latency down ~32% (19ms -> 13ms). 95th down ~25%.
Maria: How about quality? any regressions on onboarding sets?
Sasha: Short-run (3k samples): ppl +0.7, exact-match on QA core -0.6pp, hallucination rate +1.9pp on the knowledge subset (mostly long-tail facts). Most failures are when the fast-pass returns low-confidence tokens that later get corrected by q8 — but sometimes corrections never happen because fallback threshold too strict.
Tariq: Do we have the eval command + config so I can reproduce?
Sasha: Yep — use this:
```
./run_eval \
  --model_mix fast=q4:/mnt/models/llama3-13b-q4,slow=q8:/mnt/models/llama3-13b-q8 \
  --speculative_policy per_token_confidence \
  --dataset datasets/onboard-qc-v2.jsonl \
  --samples 3000 --seed 42 \
  --metrics ppl,exact_match,rougeL,halluc_rate
```
Jonah: Good. Any pattern by prompt length / prefix?
Sasha: Failures concentrate after ~400 tokens when KV cache has seen many quantized states. drift metric increases; per-layer scale mismatch seems to accumulate for some attention heads.
Maria: So maybe per-layer bias/scale correction after warmup? or a tiny hybrid re-quant step for KV?
Sasha: Thinking: apply a fast per-layer output rescale learned on a 1k warmup subset (cheap, no full retrain). early tests reduce halluc_rate delta to +0.6pp.
Tariq: Can you drop the logs path + the quick diff table?
Sasha: logs: s3://redwood-dev/eng-ml/microcascade/1739999001/runA/
Sasha: quick diff table (3k):
- baseline(q8): ppl 12.1 | exact 72.4% | hall_rate 3.2%
- microcascade(q4->q8): ppl 12.8 | exact 71.8% | hall_rate 5.1%
Jonah: Not great but promising. Next steps?
Sasha: Plan:
1) Run full 10k sweep (q4 vs q8) with per-layer rescale enabled/disabled.
2) Add KV-warmup (512-token staged warmup) and re-eval.
3) Canary at 5% traffic with automatic fallback to q8 after 1 failed token correction.
4) If hall_rate delta > +1pp on canary, auto rollback.
Maria: For the 10k sweep, can you add a small perplexity-likelihood calibration plot? helps to pick fallback threshold.
Sasha: Will do. ETA for sweep: EOD tomorrow.
Tariq: If you want, I can run a lightweight human spot-check on the 200 example failure subset.
Sasha: pls, that would help categorize hallucination types.
deploy-bot: Canary toggled: micro-cascade v0.1 -> 5% on dedicated-us-west pool :rocket:
Jonah: thx. let's sync tomorrow after sweep results — bring any short reproducer prompts.
Sasha: cc @Maria @Tariq — I'll post the 10k artifacts and the threshold plots in this thread when done. :white_check_mark:
